The fresh on-r1 reader read the lead as saying exactly what to do and found the category counts add up to the counter (item 17). Two points off, as in round 1: “card” is said by what it holds («مختصر تعارف», N306: no «کارڈ»; the popup does carry the summary, MapView.astro line 208, proof item 5), and the Arabic’s two verbs (choose a category / press a place) are one Urdu verb, «چنیں» — no native device-neutral verb for “press a link” is in the line’s evidence (N89, P16-test).

nativeness.why: Scored afresh on both blind reads (on-05, on-r1). Confirmed: the lead after round 1’s «چنیں» (on-r1 item 17: reads well; it answers on-05 items 7 and 19), the empty notice, the counter and the location message (on-05 21, on-r1 18); no reader raised anything on the title, eyebrow, search field, chip «سب», list label or popup link. Five points off. Three for the terrain link label «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ», now contested by TWO readers, both moderate (on-05 5 on the «سہ جہتی» wording; on-r1 14 on the r1 wording: “bookish, long”, understood as a 3D terrain map after a second read): round 1’s «سہ» → «تین» did not lift the charge, which now rests on «نشیب و فراز» and the length; no plainer native phrase for “terrain” is in the line’s evidence (the reader’s «اونچائی نیچائی» and round 1’s option «اونچ نیچ» are unattested here; his «3D» is Latin). One for the chip-group label «زمرے کے لحاظ سے مقامات کا انتخاب», minor to two readers (on-05 19, on-r1 16), never seen. One for the locate label, a bare noun phrase that does not say what the button does (on-05 8, minor; the source’s form; not raised on r1).

compliance.why: Letterforms, digits and punctuation clean (proof on r1: 402 code points, none of U+064A U+0643 U+0629 U+0647 U+0649 U+0623 U+0625 U+06C3; five U+06BE, all after aspirable letters; no Persian or Arabic-Indic digit, no NBSP); «الاحساء» byte for byte in the ruled possessive (P2, P8, N47); approved text reused byte for byte (map.eyebrow = list.eyebrow, map.search.ph = list.search, map.empty = search.empty + the category branch, «سیاحتی مقامات», «←» as det.allSights); P16 held (no «کارڈ», «ٹیپ», «کلک», «تھری ڈی», «شیئر»); N308 held; {n} once; both termbase_final keys byte for byte in map.terrain. Round 1’s point is restored on re-weighing: the masculine of «انتخاب» is now READ on its entry (rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-intiKHaab, HTTP 200, “Noun, Masculine, Singular”, proof p1-intikhab2.txt) and «مقامات کا انتخاب» agrees; «تین جہتی» is verified on usage attestation alone, which has precedent for a compound of two common words («مصنوعی جنگل», «مہاجر پرندے», «ریت کے ٹیلے»), and its record now claims nothing more (the false part of speech is struck, proof item 1). The record defects the proof found (proof items 1, 2) are corrected in this round; they were never in the text.

fit.why: The traveller learns how many places the map holds, how to narrow them and how to open one (on-r1 item 17); the counter is spoken after every filter; the empty notice tells him what to change. One point off: the terrain link opens an English page under an Urdu label (N308, owner_decision: no language note), and the on-r1 reader could not tell whether it opens another page or changes this map (item 14); the locate label leaves its action to the button role.

تین جہتی.note: STAGE 7 (b21-ui, round 1): N331 C ruled, replacing the stage-1/4 proposal «سہ جہتی» in map.terrain after the on-05 blind reader called it bookish (item 5). calibration.question: map.terrain: how is “3D” said in Urdu, where no Latin letter is allowed (EN “3D terrain map”, AR «الخريطة التضاريسية 3D»)?
candidates: A «سہ جہتی» — «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا سہ جہتی نقشہ» (stages 1–5).
B «تھری ڈی» — the English letters spelled in Urdu script.
C «تین جہتی» — «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ».
calibration.evidence: Stage 4 (s45-web.json, HTTP 200): A Rekhta headword «سَہ جِہَتی» “three dimensional” (the entry carries no part-of-speech label), ur.wikipedia 41 pages, «سہ جہتی نقشہ» 1 (چندریان-2); B 607 pages, film formats and product names, no headword, «تھری ڈی نقشہ» 0; C 37 pages, among them the reference article «نقشہ» («… دو جہتی ہوتے ہیں، تین جہتی …»); D 18, mathematics and physics. Re-counted by the judge 2026-10-16 (s7-web.json, HTTP 200): «تین جہتی» 37 (top titles کرہ ارض · نقشہ · تصویر), «سہ جہتی» 41, «تین جہتی نقشہ» 0. Rekhta: no entry page for «تین جہتی» under the three slugs tried (meaning-of-tiin-jihatii, meaning-of-teen-jihatii, meaning-of-tiin-jahatii — all three redirect to the home page, proof re-fetch 2026-10-16, p1-rekhta.txt); the entry «سہ جہتی» answers (meaning-of-sah-jihatii, HTTP 200, “three dimensional”, no part of speech on its card — p1-sah.txt). Blind reader on-05 item 5 (moderate): «سہ جہتی» and «نشیب و فراز» “bookish and over-Persianized”. Blind reader on-r1 item 14 (moderate), on the C wording: “bookish, long label”, understood after a second read; he does not single out «تین جہتی», his own form writes the Latin «3D»; no count reading of «تین» after the chip count «(3)» reported.
calibration.stage4_recommendation: A stays; C is the fallback if the blind reader finds «سہ» bookish or unknown.
calibration.ruling_or_recommendation: C: «تین جہتی» — map.terrain «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ». The on-05 reader’s charge is the condition stage 4 set for the fallback, and between two native words a reader’s stumble is evidence (the restriction of P16 is on loans). C is the plainer of the two, the wording the reference article on maps uses, and needs no Latin letter and no figure. B refused: P16-test (2) is met, but (1) is not (the reference names 3D maps natively, A and C) and (3) is not (no headword); a stumble alone never admits a loan. A withdrawn from this string; it stays a correct headword and is recorded in C’s entry for search. D not taken (technical). Cost: «تین جہتی» has no entry page of its own (both parts are common words; the compound is attested in use). ROUND 2: proofed on r1 (must-fix 0) and read blind on r1; C kept — the second reader’s charge falls on the label’s length and on «نشیب و فراز» (N333), not on «تین جہتی», and «سہ جہتی» cannot return (it was contested by the first reader).
calibration.binds: map.terrain; every later interface string that says “3D” (tmap.* when the terrain page is translated).
calibration.guard: Stage checker: none of «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا سہ جہتی نقشہ», «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تھری ڈی نقشہ», «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا سہ ابعادی نقشہ» occurs. For the proofreader, not machine-read: “3D” is «تین جہتی», never the Latin «3D» and never the loan «تھری ڈی». The machine clause bans exactly the three full map.terrain labels this entry withdrew (A), refused (B) or did not take (D), never the word «سہ جہتی» or «تین جہتی» elsewhere.

(2) Souq al-Hamidiyah is filed under historic sites though its name says market (two readers looked for it under markets). (3) «سوق الحمیدیہ» / «سوق القیصریہ» keep «سوق» where other markets say «بازار» (readers: «حمیدیہ بازار»). (4) Bare Arabic names with nothing to say what they are: «دوغہ الغراش», «رباط آل ابی بکر الملا», «بیت البیعہ», «مدرسہ امیریہ». (5) «اشتراک کریں»: readers expect «شیئر کریں» (N3 / P16-test refused it). (6) «جبل کنزان پارک (الشعبہ)» under nature, bracket unexplained, beside «جبل کنزان». (7) «جبل» in names vs «جھیل» for lakes (P3a). (8) «الخلیفہ کا ورثہ عجائب گھر» (read as a calque, moderate on r1), «الاحساء کے روایتی گھر کا عجائب گھر», «کھیلوں کے اسٹیڈیم کا پارک» read heavy or generic. (9) The zoo under parks; «العقیر» bare beside three «العقیر کا/کی …» entries. (10) «جھیل الدیلفوون»: the doubled «وو» read as a typo by two readers — re-check against the Arabic. (11) The header «بازار، پارک اور زرعی فارم» vs the category chips (navigation queue). (12) Mosque titles in two orders («مسجد X» / «X کی مسجد») split mosques across the alphabetical list (new on r1). (13) The terrain link label «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ» read as bookish and long by two readers: a plainer native phrase for “terrain” («زمین کی اونچ نیچ», «اونچائی نیچائی») would need its own evidence — best ruled when the terrain page itself is translated (tmap.*); and readers cannot tell the link opens another (English) page (N308). (14) Option, not taken: the locate button as an action, «نقشے پر میری جگہ دکھائیں» (the source is a noun phrase).
